question: The sides (in cm) of a right triangle are (x − 13), (x − 26) and x. Its area (in cm²) is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Identify the **right triangle triplet** by observing the gap between sides.

The sides are **x − 26**, **x − 13**, and **x** (where **x** is the **hypotenuse**).

The common difference is **13**. Scaling the standard **5, 12, 13 triplet** by **13**:

**5×13, 12×13, 13×13 → 65, 156, 169**. Here **169 − 13 = 156** and **169 − 26 = 143** (does not match 65).

Using **x = 78**: Sides are **78 − 26 = 52**, **78 − 13 = 65**, and **78** (Not a triplet). Using **x = 39**: **13, 26, 39** (No).

Correct triplet calculation: **x² = (x−13)² + (x−26)² → x = 65**. Sides: **39, 52, 65** (Scaled **3, 4, 5 triplet** by 13).

**Area = 1/2 × 39 × 52 = 39 × 26 = 1014 cm²**.

**∴ The correct answer is 1014 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Sides are (x − 26), (x − 13) and **hypotenuse** x.

**Formula:** **Base² + Perpendicular² = Hypotenuse²**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51b9176fe17614d3c86362e77532faa641128e905e47f899a5eb99a37001f469.png] 

⇒ (x − 26)² + (x − 13)² = x²

⇒ (x² − 52x + 676) + (x² − 26x + 169) = x²

⇒ 2x² − 78x + 845 = x²

⇒ x² − 78x + 845 = 0

⇒ x² − 65x − 13x + 845 = 0

⇒ x(x − 65) − 13(x − 65) = 0

⇒ (x − 65)(x − 13) = 0

⇒ x = 65 (Since x − 26 must be positive, x > 26)

⇒ Base = 65 − 26 = 39 cm, Height = 65 − 13 = 52 cm

⇒ Area = 1/2 × Base × Height = 1/2 × 39 × 52

⇒ Area = 39 × 26 = 1014 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 1014 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Pythagorean Triplets

Common triplets like (3, 4, 5), (5, 12, 13), and (8, 15, 17) can be scaled by a constant k to find other right triangles (3k, 4k, 5k).

Area of Right Triangle

The area is always half the product of the two shorter sides (legs): Area = 1/2 × a × b.

Quadratic Roots Shortcut

For x² − (sum of roots)x + (product of roots) = 0, identify factors of the constant that add up to the middle coefficient.</p
